messages:
lucy: noticed flaky behaviour in the go generator sample when cancelling long-running streams. ctrl-C returns from the stream handler but the process doesn't exit. pprof shows goroutines stuck in the auth refresh path.

omar: can you share the pattern?

lucy: simplified flow: spawn a background refresher that calls a blocking getToken(); main uses context cancel on SIGTERM and passes that ctx to Generate(). Generate returns, cancel called, but refresher still blocks because getToken() has no ctx cancel.

pri: this is an onboarding DX bug. users expect cancel to tear down everything. SDK should either provide a context-aware token refresh interface or we should show an example wrapper in sampleapp.

omar: agreed. quick wins: 1) update sample app to use signal.NotifyContext and show wrapping blocking refresh with a ctx-aware http client; 2) add NewContextAdapter(tokenSource) in the SDK that runs refresh with a context.

lucy: also add an FAQ blurb: "Why won't my process exit after cancelling a generator?" explaining blocking token refresh + retries.

pri: tests: create a net/http test server that accepts connections but delays response to simulate a stalled token service, assert process teardown within N seconds.

ci-bot: Created ticket RW-4520: "go sdk: context-aware token refresh + sampleapp guidance".

lucy: i'll open the sampleapp PR first, then a follow-up SDK change. tagging @omar for review. thanks!
